newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan c.bank says won't act on interbank rates.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan c.bank says won't act on interbank rates.

text.p: The Taiwan central bank has said it hopes soaring overnight interbank rates will stabilise, but will not inject funds to loosen liquidity or issue certificates to tighten it.

"The central bank hopes the short-term interest rate will be stable, but we haven't considered injecting funds," a central bank official quoted banking department chief Li Sheng-yen as telling reporters late on Monday.
"At the same time, we will not issue negotiable certificates of deposit to tighten liquidity," he quoted Li as saying.
